title: de.hubtask.work.label.deleted.v1
description: A label was taken out of a collection's vocabulary. Single-value enums stand in for `const`, and the bounds of a value are stated in its description rather than as keywords: the contract test validates against this file with the subset of JSON Schema the project implements, and a keyword it silently ignored would be a promise nobody checks. The wire format is a CloudEvent 1.0 in structured JSON (ADR-0007); the tenant, the actor and the causal chain travel as CloudEvents extension attributes, whose names are lower case without separators as the specification requires. Fields may be added; removing or reinterpreting one requires a .v2 delivered alongside .v1 for at least two minor releases (domain-model.md §4).

id.description: UUIDv7. Stable across delivery attempts, so a consumer deduplicates on it (at-least-once delivery).

source.description: The installation and the bounded context that produced the event.

subject.description: What the event is about, so that a consumer can filter without parsing the payload.

actorid.description: Absent when the system itself acts. No label: an event leaves the installation, and a name is personal data a subscriber does not need in order to react (ADR-0018).

onbehalfof.description: The principal an automation rule or an agent runs as.

correlationid.description: Everything that came out of one original action carries the same value. A root event is its own correlation.

causationid.description: The event that caused this one. Absent for an action a person took.

causationdepth.description: Distance from the original action. The rule engine stops at 5 and marks the run ABORTED_LOOP (automation.md §2).

data.description: A snapshot of the label as it was deleted. The entries that carried it are not named: a collection's vocabulary is small and its entries are not, so listing them would make the payload unbounded.

collection_id.description: The collection whose vocabulary this label belongs to. A label does not survive a move to another collection (invariant I-W6).

name.description: At most 120 characters, on one line, unique in the collection without regard to case or accents.

color_token.description: A theme token rather than a colour value. Required: a label is rendered as a chip and nothing else.

deleted_at.description: When the label was taken out of the vocabulary. Null on a live one; a label is deleted softly, so that the entries that carried it keep a reference that resolves.
